name: datasync
description: DataSync In addition to the Amazon Web Services Management Console and Amazon Web Services Command Line Interface, you can use the DataSync API to configure and manage DataSync with the Amazon Web Services SDKs.

subcommands.name: cancel-task-execution
subcommands.description: Stops an DataSync task execution that's in progress.

subcommands.name: create-agent
subcommands.description: Activates an DataSync agent that you deploy in your storage environment.

subcommands.name: create-location-azure-blob
subcommands.description: Creates a transfer location for a Microsoft Azure Blob Storage container.

subcommands.name: create-location-efs
subcommands.description: Creates a transfer location for an Amazon EFS file system.

subcommands.name: create-location-fsx-lustre
subcommands.description: Creates a transfer location for an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system.

subcommands.name: create-location-fsx-ontap
subcommands.description: Creates a transfer location for an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system.

subcommands.name: create-location-fsx-open-zfs
subcommands.description: Creates a transfer location for an Amazon FSx for OpenZFS file system.

subcommands.name: create-location-fsx-windows
subcommands.description: Creates a transfer location for an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system.

subcommands.name: create-location-hdfs
subcommands.description: Creates a transfer location for a Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS).

subcommands.name: create-location-nfs
subcommands.description: Creates a transfer location for a Network File System (NFS) file server.

subcommands.name: create-location-object-storage
subcommands.description: Creates a transfer location for an object storage system.

subcommands.name: create-location-s3
subcommands.description: Creates a transfer location for an Amazon S3 bucket.

subcommands.name: create-location-smb
subcommands.description: Creates a transfer location for a Server Message Block (SMB) file server.

subcommands.name: create-task
subcommands.description: Configures a task, which defines where and how DataSync transfers your data.

subcommands.name: delete-agent
subcommands.description: Removes an DataSync agent resource from your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: delete-location
subcommands.description: Deletes a transfer location resource from DataSync.

subcommands.name: delete-task
subcommands.description: Deletes a transfer task resource from DataSync.

subcommands.name: describe-agent
subcommands.description: Returns information about an DataSync agent, such as its name, service endpoint type, and status.

subcommands.name: describe-location-azure-blob
subcommands.description: Provides details about how an DataSync transfer location for Microsoft Azure Blob Storage is configured.

subcommands.name: describe-location-efs
subcommands.description: Provides details about how an DataSync transfer location for an Amazon EFS file system is configured.

subcommands.name: describe-location-fsx-lustre
subcommands.description: Provides details about how an DataSync transfer location for an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system is configured.

subcommands.name: describe-location-fsx-ontap
subcommands.description: Provides details about how an DataSync transfer location for an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system is configured.

subcommands.name: describe-location-fsx-open-zfs
subcommands.description: Provides details about how an DataSync transfer location for an Amazon FSx for OpenZFS file system is configured.

subcommands.name: describe-location-fsx-windows
subcommands.description: Provides details about how an DataSync transfer location for an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system is configured.

subcommands.name: describe-location-hdfs
subcommands.description: Provides details about how an DataSync transfer location for a Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) is configured.

subcommands.name: describe-location-nfs
subcommands.description: Provides details about how an DataSync transfer location for a Network File System (NFS) file server is configured.

subcommands.name: describe-location-object-storage
subcommands.description: Provides details about how an DataSync transfer location for an object storage system is configured.

subcommands.name: describe-location-s3
subcommands.description: Provides details about how an DataSync transfer location for an S3 bucket is configured.

subcommands.name: describe-location-smb
subcommands.description: Provides details about how an DataSync transfer location for a Server Message Block (SMB) file server is configured.

subcommands.name: describe-task
subcommands.description: Provides information about a task, which defines where and how DataSync transfers your data.

subcommands.name: describe-task-execution
subcommands.description: Provides information about an execution of your DataSync task.

subcommands.name: list-agents
subcommands.description: Returns a list of DataSync agents that belong to an Amazon Web Services account in the Amazon Web Services Region specified in the request.

subcommands.name: list-locations
subcommands.description: Returns a list of source and destination locations.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns all the tags associated with an Amazon Web Services resource.

subcommands.name: list-task-executions
subcommands.description: Returns a list of executions for an DataSync transfer task.

subcommands.name: list-tasks
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the DataSync tasks you created.

subcommands.name: start-task-execution
subcommands.description: Starts an DataSync transfer task.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Applies a tag to an Amazon Web Services resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from an Amazon Web Services resource.

subcommands.name: update-agent
subcommands.description: Updates the name of an DataSync agent.

subcommands.name: update-location-azure-blob
subcommands.description: Modifies the following configurations of the Microsoft Azure Blob Storage transfer location that you're using with DataSync.

subcommands.name: update-location-efs
subcommands.description: Modifies the following configuration parameters of the Amazon EFS transfer location that you're using with DataSync.

subcommands.name: update-location-fsx-lustre
subcommands.description: Modifies the following configuration parameters of the Amazon FSx for Lustre transfer location that you're using with DataSync.

subcommands.name: update-task
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of a task, which defines where and how DataSync transfers your data.

subcommands.name: update-task-execution
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of a running DataSync task execution.
